mo_ta_cong_viec:
Overview
We are looking for a Senior Golang Backend Engineer to build and optimize high-concurrency, realtime backend services running on Kubernetes and AWS.
This role focuses on microservices, event streaming, caching, and scalable architecture for realtime workloads.
You will work on systems that handle large traffic, low latency, and high availability using Kafka, Redis, WebSocket/gRPC and cloud-native infrastructure.
Responsibilities
Develop backend services in Golang with focus on concurrency and performance
Design and maintain microservices architecture deployed on Kubernetes
Build realtime services using WebSocket / gRPC
Use Redis (cache, Pub/Sub, session) for performance optimization
Use Kafka for event streaming and async processing
Deploy and operate services on AWS (EKS/EC2/S3)
Collaborate with DevOps for CI/CD and containerized deployment
Participate in performance optimization and system stability improvements
Work closely with frontend, product, and DevOps teams
yeu_cau:
Requirements (Must-have)
5+ years experience with Golang
Strong knowledge of microservices, REST/gRPC
Experience with Kubernetes, Docker
Experience with Redis and Kafka
Experience building high-concurrency / realtime systems
Familiar with AWS cloud environment
Good problem solving and performance optimization mindset
Nice to have
Experience with Terraform / observability tools
Experience in game server / streaming / fintech / realtime platform
Knowledge of secure communication (TLS/mTLS)
quyen_loi:
Work on system-level, high traffic architecture
Opportunity to grow into Senior/Tech Lead in distributed systems
Modern tech stack: Golang, Kafka, Redis, K8s, AWS
